stubbed: cloud_burst: detector fully implemented (frame-to-frame IR10.8 cooling rate), but the real 71-file nat_in archive doesn't contain true 15-min-cadence consecutive frames for any city -- see per-alert 'STUBBED' messages.
heavy_rain: cold-cloud-duration proxy runs on whatever same-day frames exist (often only 2-3, not the ideal 15-min series) -- confidence capped low to reflect this.

heat_wave/cold_wave/frost WRF cross-check: the only real WRF D02 output on disk is dated 2026-07-20, which does not overlap the real MSG archive (2026-06-22..07-15) -- every cross-check reports the actual day-gap it used instead of assuming same-day alignment.
uv_index: explicitly a coarse clear-sky/high-sun proxy, not a calibrated UV index (needs ozone-column data neither MSG nor MTG carries) -- labeled as such in every alert message.

residue_burning: detector is new this week (Week 3) and fully implemented (reuses the real night_fog_diff/IR3.9-IR10.8 field), but the real 71-file nat_in archive covers 2026-06-22..07-20 -- Kharif SOWING season, not Punjab's real post-harvest residue-burning season (Oct-Nov). This run cannot demonstrate a true positive; it only confirms the detector runs and does not spuriously false-alarm on off-season, presumably-fire-free real data. Also coarse (0.25 deg / ~27km grid) -- only plausible for widespread simultaneous burning, not a single field's fire.

national extension (--locations districts): 126 district-centroid points sampled from the same 0.25 deg grid the 12-city pilot always used (grid itself already covered 55-85E,20-40N -- this changes sampling density, not source-data coverage). District centroids closer together than ~0.25 deg (~27km) can land in the same grid cell and read identically -- true sub-grid spatial resolution has not changed. No Urdu district names in the source boundary set, name_ur falls back to name_en for district locations.
